description.zh:
元数据ID列表，多个ID之间用英文半角逗号（,）分隔。

您可以在ARMS控制台目标应用的**异常分析**页面获取异常ID。
description.en:
The metadata IDs. Use a comma (,) to separate multiple IDs.

You can obtain the exception ID on the **exception analysis** page of the target application in the ARMS console.

description.zh:
元数据类型：

- sql：通过sqlId获取SQL语句
- exception：通过exceptionId返回异常堆栈
description.en:
The type of the metadata. Valid values:

- sql: Retrieves the SQL statement by sqlId.

- exception: Retrieves the exception stack by exceptionId.

description.zh: 应用的ID标识串，可以通过**ListTraceApps**接口获取。
description.en: The application ID. To obtain the ID, call the **ListTraceApps** operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms query-app-metadata --meta-ids 4c9dd447,3c76c565 --meta-type sql --pid ggxw4lnjuz@54364d85b000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time-ms 1 --end-time-ms 1 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
